bayts.text: Praise be to Allah, the Generous, Possessor of favours, for my devotion to the obligations and the traditions (sunan).
I have thanked Him because He drove me to a homeland in which He removed what hindered me,
and led me to Him by adorning (with virtues), after He had refined me by stripping (of vices),
and drew me there toward the sciences, triumph and acting upon what is known.
Then a blessing with peace, following, upon him whom it is my aim to follow,
upon him for whom whoever follows the example of his will, in secret and in public, becomes an example.
He is the one who emigrated to Medina by the command of his Lord, and so preserved his religion:
my means of approach to my Sovereign, the Exalted, Muḥammad, the best of creation, the Intercessor,
and (upon) his Family and his Companions, the stars, who subdued the souls and the accursed (Satan).
That said: truly today, O Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), I fear none but You in the two Abodes.
And truly I, O Kind (Al-Barr), O Generous, am a supplicant, and from gratitude I never depart,
ever since You drew me to You, O Helper, out of a care from You toward me, to help (me).
And I rose, drawn toward You by You, through You, (relying) on You, and I was well pleased with You,
entrusting and surrendering to You my affair, emigrating toward what is with You.
Then toward You, not toward any other than You, I journeyed, since I found none like You.
And You have bestowed on me today the best of favours, and led me to follow the traditions (of the Prophet),
after the praise of people had almost made me enter the snare of the Whisperer (Qurʾān 114:4),
and for praises and eulogies I almost lost interest in composing and in teaching recitation,
in learning and in teaching, and in devoting myself to the guidance of knowledge.
So I said, with gratitude and seeking means through the Chosen, the Intercessor, the very essence of the Messengers,
and through his sons and his daughters together, that they may intercede for me swiftly, all of them:
"O Kind, O Forgiving, O Forbearing (Al-Ḥalīm), I am an untried one, repentant, blameworthy.
O Kind, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Trustee (Al-Wakīl), I am lazy, a sleeper, a glutton.
O my Sovereign, O Creator of mankind, put my passion to death, lessen my sleep.
O my Creator, O Perfect in attributes, to You I have complained of the multitude of (my) afflictions.
And You are the Possessor of Majesty and Bounty (Qurʾān 55:27): save me and grant me my aim.
From You I long today to be among those who refused to lean on any other than You,
and to obey You by the way of the Chosen, his radiant Sunna, O You Who chose (him).
O Forgiver of sins, O Near (Al-Qarīb), I am a lowly servant, a stranger here.
Grant me, through that one (the Prophet), and all my brothers, the felicity of the two Abodes, truly, O All-Hearing (As-Samīʿ).
Grant me in this supplication the answering, through the Chosen, the Family and the Companions.
Grant me the best share in the apportionings, and (grant it) to the people of religion, by the standing of al-Qāsim.
And dispel for me the pitch-black night of passion, by the sanctity of the beloved Ibrāhīm.
And drive to me the best lawful and wholesome provision and the best neighbours, by the right of aṭ-Ṭayyib.
And purify me inwardly and outwardly, and through me have mercy on creation, by the right of aṭ-Ṭāhir.
And raise me with a hidden raising, by his daughter Ruqayya, the pure.
And spare from my harm the near and the stranger, the Muslim and the unbeliever, by Zaynab.
And turn toward me with good and safety, by Umm Kulthūm, until the Resurrection.
And bestow on me, Lord, a good ending, here and in my tomorrow, by the standing of Fāṭima.
Bless their father, the Family and his Companions, and answer my request for me.
And be my intimate companion, and protect me from harm, and save me from delusion and peril.
And save, Lord, me and the people of my house, here and tomorrow, from troubles.
And save me and the Muslims from affliction, and protect my body in my grave from decay.
O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Beloved!
Grant me, by the standing of him who is the Chosen (al-Mukhtār), in this world and the Next, the best of what I choose.
And set a veil between us and every harm, and keep ruin away from us.
O Allah, O Helper (An-Naṣīr), O Majestic (Al-Jalīl), I am lowly, destitute, abased.
So make me free of need through You, and grant me my need, through him who rose above all non-Arabs and Arabs:
our master Muḥammad, the gate of success, my means of approach to You in attaining righteousness.
And bless and grant peace upon him and upon everyone who has attached himself to him.
And forgive my sins and accept my deeds, and grant me the best of wishes and hopes.
O You Who are above place and accident, I dwell here and in me is an illness:
so be my intimate companion and heal me of sickness, until I walk the best road.
O Just (Al-ʿAdl), O Abaser (Al-Mudhill), O You Who give security: You are my protector here, O Giver of security (Al-Muʾmin).
And forever be my securer, O Possessor of Majesty, from every evil, punishment and error.
O You Who are above (having) a wife or a child, encompass me and encompass all the people of this land.
And make, O my God, my dwelling Ṭūbā (Touba) forever like its name (the tree of Paradise), by the standing of the best of worshippers.
And bless him with the most excellent blessing, and his Family and his Companions, possessors of (true) bonds.
